posts.title: Updating {Very} Outdated Proxmox Installs
posts.description: Sometimes life gets away from you and, well, you don’t perform the maintenance on your homelab that you really should have. It’s been an… interesting few years and I had a couple of Proxmox nodes that were a tiny bit, um… outdated. To get a quick idea of what you’re in for, we’re going from Proxmox version 7 on Debian 11, to Proxmox version 8 on Debian 12, to Proxmox version 9 on Debian 13.
